description: How often home-purchase applications in a US county were approved or denied in the latest HMDA year, the most common reasons for denial, and the lenders that made the most home loans there — each with applications, loans made, denial rate and median rate. From the federal Home Mortgage Disclosure Act public loan records. Counts and rates only; nothing is ranked or recommended. Small lenders below HMDA's reporting threshold, including many credit unions in the directory, are not counted.

county.description: US county name, e.g. 'Harris County'. A city name also works ('Houston' → Harris County).

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

name: origen_home_loan_approvals
title: Who approves home loans in a US county
